about_the_game:
In Once Up, you accompany Cliff Hanger, a small elephant who, after a deep fall, gets separated from his parents on his journey. Along the way, he discovers a huge, delicious-looking peanut, which, after eating it, grants him an incredible ability: Whenever he latches onto surfaces, he becomes weightless and can sling himself through the air.

 

  • Draw magical sketches from your book to shape your path through each level.

  • Collect peanuts to unlock hidden areas – who knows what secrets they hold?

  • Try out the procedural level generator – no two runs are the same!

  • Climb seemingly unreachable towers – with skill, timing, and a pinch of magic.

  • Play in different game modes and find your own rhythm.

  • Step into a variety of fairy tales and listen to their unique songs – each one tells its own story.

No fairy tales here... well, not those kind of fairy tales. ^-^

A Fairy Tale Book as the Game World

The game unfolds across the pages of an old-fashioned fairy tale book, which you explore page by page. But these are not your usual fairy tales! Instead of old drawings, you’ll find silly, cartoon-like, hand-drawn illustrations. 

Build Your Own Climbing Paths

Using the drawings from the fairy tale book, you can create your own climbing paths, which you then climb to collect peanuts. These are necessary to unlock new areas of the book and discover new challenges.

Climb the Tower

The main goal in Once Up is to climb a giant tower made from the collected drawings in order to return to your family.

Music from Old Fairy Tales

The music was inspired by reading old, well-known fairy tales, which I have rewritten and summarized in verse. With the help of AI (partly through singing and refining with AI) and post-production in Audacity, I was able to develop new songs from them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core Prozessor (z.B. Intel Core i3 or similar)
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics, NVIDIA GeForce 500-Serie or similar
  • Sound Card: Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-Core Prozessor (z.B. Intel Core i5 or similar)
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD Radeon RX 560 or similar
  • Sound Card: Recommended

short_description: Join Cliff Hanger, the elephant with the unique ability to latch on and become weightless! Use drawings from an old fairy tale book to create your own climbing paths, conquer tricky sections, and collect peanuts to unlock new levels.
